channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump says he still has confidence in Fed Chair Warsh, demands 1% or lower interest rates
item.description: President Donald Trump previously threatened to cut off trade with countries that have trade surpluses with the U.S. if the Fed doesn't cut interest rates.

item.title: Fed meeting recap: Warsh says inflation is still too high as Fed hikes for the first time since 2023
item.description: The Federal Reserve raised its benchmark interest rate by a quarter percentage point.

item.title: House advances bill to rein in AI data center utility costs
item.description: The bipartisan legislation would create a regulatory framework states could adopt to prevent data center-related energy costs from being passed on to consumers.

item.title: Stock futures rise after Fed's rate hike spurs a market sell-off: Live updates
item.description: In a widely anticipated move, the Fed raised the overnight funds rate by a quarter percentage point and signaled another hike could come this year.

item.title: House votes to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress over Epstein subpoenas defiance
item.description: Billionaire Leon Black is suing the House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform seeking to block subpoenas it issued him in its probe of Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: OpenAI reports 6 new instances of 'concerning model behavior' since March
item.description: OpenAI has disclosed six new cases of model misbehavior and offered a framework for disclosing future instances, as the debate over AI model safety intensifies.

item.title: Now that the Fed raised rates, where to score the best yields on your cash
item.description: From money market funds to Treasury bills, where experts are stashing their cash — and some of the yields they're finding.

item.title: House passes sweeping Russia sanctions bill honoring Lindsey Graham, sends to Trump
item.description: The Lindsey Graham Russia sanctions bill is on a path to become law after the House votes in favor.

item.title: Amazon obtains right to buy stock in Generac, boosting power company's share price by over 40%
item.description: Amazon was granted warrants to buy up to $340 million worth of Generac stock as part of a deal to supply backup power generators for its data centers.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: The world’s largest real-time payments system will no longer be free for all
item.description: India's digital payment system, which processes more than 1 million transactions every two minutes for free now, will start charging fees to merchants.

item.title: Hyperscaler debt signals warning sign, Apollo cautions
item.description: Credit default swaps for companies building data centers are getting pricier, and it's not because banks are hedging more of their bets.

item.title: 'Science fiction': Transport companies — the backbone of economy — are sounding alarm on fuel prices
item.description: Prices for diesel, the fuel type used to power trucks and trains, came in at an all-time high of $6.31 per gallon on Wednesday.

item.title: Trump's Kennedy Center closure is 'unlawful,' Rep. Beatty tells judge in emergency hearing request
item.description: President Donald Trump says renovations at the Kennedy Center will not occur until the courts allow his name to be restored on the performing arts center.

item.title: Boeing CEO: 737 Max production taking 'a little bit longer' to stabilize than expected
item.description: Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg said wing production at its Renton, Washington, factory is a hold up, adding the company has plans to address it.

item.title: Jeff Gundlach says the Fed should have hiked rates by more to fight rising inflation
item.description: The Fed should have hiked rates by half percentage point rather than a quarter, the investor told CNBC.

item.title: Intel is leading chip gains. A top analyst sees the stock hitting $200 in two years
item.description: Intel could hit as much as $200 per share in two years as it continues to strike lucrative deals with top chipmakers, per Melius Research.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield climbs back to 5% after Fed hikes rates, Warsh highlights inflation risks
item.description: The 10-year yield moved above the 5% mark after a Federal Reserve rate increase and comments from Chairman Kevin Warsh highlighting persistent inflation risks.

item.title: Hegseth avoids impeachment vote with early House election recess
item.description: The House won't take a vote on impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth after House leaders decided to leave Washington a day earlier than planned.

item.title: Here is what changed in the new Fed statement under Warsh
item.description: This is a comparison of Wednesday's Federal Open Market Committee statement with the one issued after the Fed's previous policymaking meeting in July.

item.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles says she's cancer free
item.description: Susie Wiles oversaw Trump’s winning 2024 presidential campaign and has wielded major influence in his second administration.

item.title: Fed delivers its first hike in 3 years. Plus, what's moving Starbucks and GE Vernova
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: Higher rates can be good news for savers — but the best place for your cash depends on when you’ll need it
item.description: High-yield savings accounts and CDs both help your cash earn more interest, but each work best for different savings timelines.

item.title: Analysis: How Trump could reignite the Fed independence fight after Warsh's rate hike
item.description: The Federal Reserve unanimously raised interest rates by a quarter point despite repeated calls from President Donald Trump for lower rates.

item.title: Fed raises rates: What it means for your credit cards, mortgages, savings accounts and auto loans
item.description: The Fed's quarter-point rate hike will impact a range of consumer borrowing and savings costs, including mortgages, credit cards, car loans and deposit rates.

item.title: Anthropic policy chief says AI companies can't be expected to operate on 'honor code'
item.description: Sarah Heck, Anthropic's head of public policy, offered her perspectives on AI safety as the debate about how to regulate model development intensifies.

item.title: Consumers hit by one-two punch of oil and rates from Iran war. The estimated bill is $1,700 per household
item.description: Rising oil prices and Treasury yields are lifting energy and borrowing costs for U.S. households, pushing consumers to draw more heavily on savings.

item.title: Living abroad doesn't end your U.S. tax obligations. What young expats need to know
item.description: Americans living overseas may still face U.S. tax-filing and foreign-account reporting rules — even when they ultimately owe no U.S. income tax.

item.title: Trump donor Harold Hamm's Continental Resources to develop oil region in Venezuela
item.description: Continental said it undertook an "independent evaluation of opportunities" in Venezuela after President Donald Trump called for the industry to invest.

item.title: Sen. Blumenthal urges AI oversight: 'We're on the verge of losing control'
item.description: The Trump administration argues that beating China in the race to AI dominance is an all-important goal.

item.title: American Airlines says 30% of seats drive half of revenue as premium cabin rush heats up
item.description: American says a minority of its seats now accounts for half of its revenue.
